description: This file defines the Permissions interface, which extends Set<Permission> and Jsonifiable, providing capabilities to manage and serialize a set of permissions within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for instantiation, JSON serialization, and schema version support, specifically for API version 1.

classes.name: Permissions
classes.description: An interface representing a specialized set of Permission objects that can be serialized to JSON and is specific to API version 1 of the permissions schema.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new mutable Permissions instance containing specified permissions.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns the JSON schema versions supported by this Permissions set, specifically API version 1.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if the set contains all specified permissions.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the permissions set to a JSON object, including only non-hidden marked fields.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the permissions set to a JSON object based on the provided schema version and field selector.
